text: {"lessons":["I sold several holdings at gains, but a realized gain alone does not show that selling was the best decision; judge each trade by its role in my overall portfolio.","I should not let my purchase price or the pain of realizing a loss decide whether to hold or sell; focus on what makes sense from today onward.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, so I should avoid trading on price history and make deliberate decisions consistent with my plan."]}
